svg.title: MaldiAMRKit preprocessing pipeline
svg.desc: Animated loop of one MALDI-TOF mass spectrum (2,000 to 20,000 m/z) moving through the MaldiAMRKit pipeline: a noisy raw spectrum on a sloped baseline is smoothed (Savitzky-Golay), its SNIP baseline is subtracted so the trace drops onto zero, the main peaks are marked, the intensities are binned into a feature vector, and a classifier outputs antimicrobial-resistance phenotypes: Ciprofloxacin R (resistant), Ceftriaxone R (resistant), Meropenem S (susceptible).

text.tspan: noisy intensities on a drifting baseline
SNIP baseline subtracted; the trace settles on zero
local maxima flagged along the m/z axis
intensities pooled into fixed-width m/z bins → feature vector
an ML classifier maps the feature vector to Resistant (R) / Susceptible (S)
